Unstructured documents include visual clues that draw human attention and convey the majority of information to readers. There have been several recent advancements in information extraction in such documents using the conventional natural language processing methodologies. However, there has been little to no work towards using the non-sequential relationships that are found only in unstructured documents for the task of information extraction. In this study, we propose novel methodologies to capture the non-sequential relationships present in the unstructured documents for the task of Named Entity Recognition (NER) using Conditional Random Field (CRF). We experiment with two different datasets having different types of logical reading order and we compare three sets of features. The NER model, that uses the proposed novel features, achieves mean F1-Scores of 68.15% on Retail Receipt and 85.54% on Air Ticket documents.

articleTitle: Kernel Least Mean Square Algorithm with Shrinkage Variable Step Size Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A novel kernel least mean square algorithm (KLMS) that uses a shrinkage variable step size is developed. In traditional KLMS, the step size is usually set a constant value for different cases, and this fixed step size methodology leads to undesirable performance in general. To address this problem, a variable step size is obtained by minimizing the energy of the noise-free a posteriori error signal which is obtained by using a known - minimization formulation. According to this approach, a shrinkage KLMS (SKLMS) algorithm is proposed. The SKLMS algorithm outperforms the original KLMS algorithm in terms of the steady-state misalignment. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm display outstanding performance in chaos time series prediction and nonlinear system identification in terms of testing MSE as compared to the traditional LMS, KLMS, shrinkage LMS, affine projection(AP), and shrinkage AP algorithms.

articleTitle: Improved Integral Analysis on Lightweight Block Cipher Midori
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As a dual cryptanalysis corresponding to differential analysis, integral cryptanalysis is more effective than differential and linear analyses in analyzing of some structures and algorithms. A new integral distinguisher for Midori is proposed in this paper by using saturating technology and combining the characteristics of the linear diffusion layer of Midori. The number of active bytes taken by our integral distinguisher is less than the number of active bytes of the distinguisher constructed by automatically searching. Furthermore, it is attacked parity bytes of key combining with the characteristic of the key schedule. To sum up, the integral analysis in this paper is the optimal integral analysis at present.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Component Model for Airborne System Health Monitoring and Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Research on airborne equipment health monitoring and prediction system is critical to aircraft maintenance and safety, and the most important of these is the selection and design of health assessment algorithms. At present, many scholars have conducted in-depth research on various sub-systems of aircraft, and have produced many research results in different aspects. These algorithms have different usage scenarios and application objects. For this problem, this paper proposes an algorithm component model, which was based on network service. This component model encapsulates various algorithms into service components, so that users can call appropriate health algorithms or combine them according to their own needs. Based on this model, the health management system prototype was developed using J2EE platform for functional verification. The results show that the design idea is feasible and meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Cell Image Segmentation Method Based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the poor cell image segmentation accuracy of traditional segmentation method, this paper introduces a supervised machine learning approach- convolutional neural network. In this paper, we implement training and execution of convolutional neural networks using the Keras, Theano, Numpy, Scipy, and Scikit-image Python packages. And the result shows that we can achieve the image segmentation by using convolutional neural networks.

articleTitle: Measurement for Instantaneous Behaviour of Remote Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Digital predistortion (DPD) is a major linearization technique for nonlinear power amplifier (PA). While DPD requires the measurement of PA instantaneous behavior for calculating PA inverse characteristic. In designing system-level DPD, it is necessary to develop a correlation algorithm for measuring the instantaneous behaviour of remote PAs when the local PA testbed is lacked. This paper proposes a novel correlation algorithm to measure the instantaneous behavior of PAs. In this proposed algorithm, the influence of PA nonlinearity and memory effects on PN sequence is modeled and compensated, and this is followed by the conventional compensation of the carrier offset. In the real measurement of a solid state PA (SSPA).

articleTitle: Virtual Machine Incremental Backup Method for Bitmap Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the QEMU underlying kernel state environment, this paper proposed a secure and efficient incremental backup method for virtual machines, which was oriented to the format of Qcow2 image files and had the characteristics of bitmap. Aiming at the disaster recovery backup problem of KVM virtual machine, this method supported users to make full and incremental remote and local backup according to backup strategy. Experiments showed that this method could efficiently generate backup files and save storage disk space.

articleTitle: Prediction of Road Conditions Ahead based on Travel Plans
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The paper is oriented to the general direction of intelligent transportation, aiming to solve the problem of only using historical data to predict road congestion ahead, and to provide a new method for alleviating urban congestion. By collecting user travel plans including route planning and navigation information, combined with vehicle travelling information and road network conditions, with the support of big data and cloud computing platforms, travel plan data collected from various channels will be integrated, and then the mathematical model is built on the master server for calculation and analysis. Finally, the future road conditions are visualized on the map in the form of a heat map, and the messages will be pushed to users according to user ID and socket information. Based on the designed application prototype, the simulation is carried out using Beijing section. The results show that the model can transparently display traffic conditions of the urban main roads for travelers and traffic control departments, solve the road congestion problem from the root, and have certain application value in terms of intelligent traffic guidance.

articleTitle: A Smart City Scenic Spot Construction Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To provide tourists with a good experience and enhance the value of natural resources, the construction of intelligent scenic spots has become the urgent task of the rapid development of tourism in China. In this paper, we first analyze the basic concept and demand analysis for a smart city scenic spot. Then, the construction framework and key implementation technologies of the smart scenic spot are given. Finally, the key technologies of the intelligent scenic spot are discussed, including ZigBee technology, video splicing, and integration, the internet protocol (IP) network public address. This construction scheme provides a new choice for the construction of intelligent scenic spots in China.

articleTitle: Study on the Safety Situation Prediction of Virtual Network Loads
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The prediction of virtual network loads is an important part of the planning in a virtual network load system, which also lays the foundation for the system’s production and operation. Therefore, sound prediction of virtual network loads is essential for the planning and the operation of virtual network load systems. Based on related literature concerning the applications of the gray neural network model in the prediction of virtual network loads, the study on the safety situation prediction of virtual network loads was provided from the perspective of the gray neural network model in this paper. The experiments showed that the prediction performance of complex virtual network loads based on the gray neural network model optimization was excellent.

Author Keywords: the Gray System Theory; prediction of virtual network loads; GM (1

articleTitle: A Study of Real Time Raster Graphic Visualization Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The grid sizes were designed to provide best quality for raster graphics. The grid data was regionally grouped into blocks and stored by partition, providing a data structure suitable for distributed parallel processing. The whole procedure from data query to grid block sub-graphic generation was fully parallel processed by an independently developed cluster, achieving high performance visualization of pixel-level raster graphics under full-HD screen resolution. The solution provides reference for the construction of similar systems.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Millimeter Wave Massive MIMO System with Low- Precision ADCs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the performance of millimeter-wave massive MIMO (Multiple-input multiple-output) system with low-precision Analog to Digital Converters (ADCs). The nonlinear quantization process is transformed into linear through Additive Quantization Noise Model (AQNM), and the closed-form expression of the uplink achievable rate is derived. The expression correctly describes the effect of the transmission power of the user, number of Radio Frequency (RF) chains at the base station, number of propagation paths and ADC quantization bits on the achievable rate. Moreover, the simulation analysis proves the correctness of the closed-form expression and obtains the conclusion that the peak of energy efficiency will be achieved when the 3 bit ADC is configured at the receiver.

articleTitle: Readmission Prediction of Diabetic based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Unplanned readmission expenses have always accounted for a large part of the expenditure of the health care system, and reducing hospital readmission rate is important for the government to reduce the financial burden and improving hospital efficiency. First of all, we preprocess the readmission records of patients, including feature creation, feature selection, imbalanced data processing, and data reduction. Then we compare the traditional machine learning algorithms and propose a convolution neural networks model combined with PCA. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the readmission prediction is effectively guaranteed, and the AUC reaches 0.97.

articleTitle: Chinese Prosodic Phrase Prediction Based on Shallow Semantic Features
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Syntactic structure features can improve the performance of prosodic phrase prediction. But only using the syntactic structure features, the performance of the algorithm is worse than the traditional text features. In this paper, we use the statistical machine learning method (CART, Adaboost and CRF) for prosodic phrase prediction based on the shallow semantic features. Experiments show that the shallow semantic features can effectively improve the performance of prosodic prediction model. And we also optimized the features, and divided them into the global and local semantic structures. The optimized experiments show that the optimized features can improve the performance of the model.

articleTitle: W Band Planar Series-Fed Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a planar series-fed linear antenna array for w band with grounded coplanar waveguide (GCPW) feeding network. The Taylor distribution is employed as the excitation amplitude coefficients of each patch, which can allow the antenna array to achieve lower side lobe level (SLL).The antenna array is designed, fabricated, and its performance evaluated. Simulation results show that a 8-element series-fed antenna array can achieve the SLL of -18.5dB and antenna gain of 14.0 dBi. The measured results show that the impedance bandwidth below -10dB is around 5GHz (|Sl1|$\leq$-10dB at 92-97 GHz).

articleTitle: A Design of Decision Engine for 5G Auto-driving Based on Ontology Slice
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the access to 5G network, auto-driving vehicles can upload their sensors’ information to Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) and get driving decision results relaying on the powerful computing ability of MEC. This article presents an architecture of intelligent decision engine running on MEC for 5G auto-driving (IDEA) by adopting the concept of ontology slice. IDEA constructs an ontoligy slice for every vehicle including sensor information, vehicle status, rule bases, etc. and provides logical isolated resources to prevent interference between ontologies. This paper gives out the method of implementing and managing of the ontology slices and method of scheduling reasoner. Besides, to make better and safer decisions, this paper also proposes an algorithm, combining an analytic strategy algorithm (WADD) and a heuristic strategy algorithm (TTB), considering both vehicle’s velocity and sensors’ refresh rate, to deal with incomplete information before making decesions. With simulation, it is shown that IDEA can provide efficient and reliable auto-driving decision service with low processing time.

articleTitle: An Improved Routing Algorithm for Service Function Chain in SDN/NFV Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: NFV (Network Function Virtualization) can realize the network function on the general X86 platform. Combined with the new SDN (Software Defined Network) network architecture and SFC (Service Function Chains), the 5G core network based on NFV can realize distributed network function on-demand deployment. However, the ever-growing network traffic makes VNF's (Virtual Network Function) type and quantity more and more variously, a good routing algorithm needs to be able to make suitable routes according to flow characteristic. In this paper, to overcome the challenges in solving link cost model, we establish a link cost model to distinguish different types of traffic. In order to avoid the solution be trapped in local optimality and reduce the complexity of the algorithm, we formulate an algorithm based on Viterbi to calculate the routing path. The simulation results show that our algorithm can improve the acceptance rate of SFC flows. Besides, it can increase the network throughput and satisfy SFC flows' demands effectively.

articleTitle: Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Noise Reduction in Low-Dose CT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To reduce the noise and artifacts in low-dose CT images, a deep convolution network with perceptual loss is proposed. The proposed model obtains a good performance on objective indicators, and makes the denoised images more acceptable to radiologists. The method learns the mapping between low-dose CT images and noise images, and combines batch normalization to accelerate the convergence speed and improve the noise reduction performance. Introducing the perceptual loss extracted by the pre-trained VGG network to effectively solve the problem of aggressive denoising. In addition, the combination of perceptual loss and L1 loss solves the problem of insufficient noise reduction. The experimental result shows that compared with the current advanced algorithms, the proposed network can better balance the noise reduction and the integrity of the organizational structure. After processing, the noise is reduced significantly and the small structure fidelity is perfectly maintained. And the texture of the soft tissue window is more complete which is the difficulty in the field of low-dose CT denoising.

articleTitle: Optimization of On-board Antenna in Near Field Area
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to further improve the communication reliability between the HF band on-board antenna and the passive transponder under the complex outdoor environment. The working performance of the antenna is studied for the PCB dielectric material, dielectric thickness and copper foil thickness used in the fabrication of the antenna. Through theoretical analysis, HFSS software modeling and physical measurement, it is shown that the best PCB dielectric material for the HF band on-board antenna is FR4 and its thickness is 2mm. Within a certain range, the thickness of the copper foil has little effect on the performance of the antenna. When using FR5 PCB material with a thickness of 2mm, the HF band on-board antenna has a 10% higher working range than existing devices, which has great practical significance for improving the communication reliability of the vehicle system and the transponder and improving the driving safety of the train.

articleTitle: Statistical Properties and Temporal Properties of Calling Behavior
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Modern information technology makes it possible to understand, model and predict human activities by analyzing electronic traces of human behavior. In this work, we analyze more than 30 million Call Data Records (CDRs) to investigate statistical properties and temporal properties of calling behavior. We find that ranked call frequency of each number can be described by a two-stage power law function. The distribution of call duration is much different and can be described by a bimodal log-normal function. Further, we confirm that both call frequency and call duration are related with circadian cycles. During daylight, call duration is strongly correlated with call frequency. However, during evening and midnight, the pattern of call duration is much different with the pattern of call frequency. Our findings have significant impact on modeling human calling activity and optimizing telecommunication services.

articleTitle: An Inversion for LF-NMR Signals Processing with BFGS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A powerful tool to process and analyze Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) signals is inversion, of which essence is to solve the Fredholm integral equation of the first kind with non-negative constraints known as an ill-conditioned problem. In this paper, an inversion method is presented based on the regularization method. The proposed objective function can turn the minimization regularization with non-negative constrains into unconstrained maximization, which is piecewise, quadratic and differentiable. The Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno (BFGS) algorithm is applied to deal with the inversion problem, and an automatic method is demonstrated to pick up regularization parameter by combining the L-curve method with generalized cross validation (GCV) method. Compared with other methods, the proposed method is capable of inversing both ID and 2D NMR signals data and obtaining reliable NMR spectrum even in the case of a low SNR. The numerical simulations and practical experiments prove the accuracy and efficiency of the inversion method.

articleTitle: Time Series Prediction and Pattern Recognition of Fault Decomposition Gas for High Voltage Composite Electrical Appliances Based on Grey System OBGM (1,N) Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The GIL/GIS is widely used in the power system. The application of grey system to forecast and analyze the time series of gas decomposition and fault pattern recognition has good engineering value for its operation condition monitoring. Based on the programming of MATLAB software environment, time series prediction model based on grey system OBGM (1,N) is realized. Based on model, grey system time series analysis algorithm is applied to predict the time-varying sequence of the volume fraction of SF6 gas decomposition products and the characteristics of the partial discharge Atlas of the high-voltage combined electrical equipment GIL/GIS in fault state. Parametric time series, grey system is further applied to data mining and analysis of association rules of time series state change, and the time series set is applied to cluster analysis of typical fault types of high-voltage GIL/GIS power equipment. The grey time series prediction and grey relational clustering analysis of small sample test data can be carried out by using the grey system to analyze large data of high voltage GIL/GIS power equipment condition assessment. The multi-dimensional and the grey system information fusion technology proposed in this paper is especially suitable for the application of the small sample and the poor data in the high-voltage GIL/GIS power equipment operation condition detection technology. The time series prediction and the pattern recognition technology of the fault decomposition gas based on the grey system OBGM (1, N) model proposed can provide some technical support for the operation and maintenance of high voltage combinations. The characteristic parameters of partial discharge pattern and grey relational clustering analysis have the good engineering and the theoretical value.

articleTitle: A Novel Localization Method Based on FDA Beam Intersection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the past localization methods, both mechanical and phased array radars require angle scanning because their beampatterns are only angle-dependent, resulting in the echo time difference only contains the range information of the target. It will cause some ambiguity problems and limitations. Since Frequency Diverse Array (FDA) was proposed, its range-angle dependent beampattern provided more degrees of freedom (DoFs) to obtain more information in array signal processing. However, how to use these increased DoFs to get more information still needs to be studied. In this paper, we propose a novel localization method using FDA beam intersection. In this proposed method, part of the FDA beampattern approximates a straight line and propagates throughout the range axis. This moving beam line can capture the target like a fast-moving net and the echo time difference contains both the angle and range information of the target. By a simple straight-line intersection, we can obtain the whole position information, where two FDA beam lines intersect at the target. A simulation diagram is provided to illustrate the proposed localization process.

articleTitle: A Specific Compression Algorithm Used for Data Acquisition of Focal Plane Arrays
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Focal plane arrays (FPA) fabricated with the state-of-the-art technology are widely used in many fields such as target detection and three-dimensional imaging, but how to handle the big data acquired by FPAs is a challenging problem. Based on the statistical distribution of output values of FPA, a specific compression algorithm is presented in this paper. By setting the template, mapping original values to symbols and adopting the lossless Huffman coding, original data can be significantly compressed. Experiments were performed to verify the performance of the proposed algorithm, resulting in compression ratios ranging from 33.4% to 37.3% and mean squared errors ranging from 2.59×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> to 1.99×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup>. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study on the compression algorithm for big data acquired from FPAs.

articleTitle: A Ditributed Algorithm for Quality Assessment of Biological Sequencing Based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: DNA sequencing technology has played an important role on life sciences, especially Illumina’s sequencer. It was used for more and more biological genomic and transcriptomic projects. Faced with the huge amount of biological sequencing data, it is a problem how to assess its quality quickly. In this paper, we developed a distributed algorithm based on MapReduce, which can assess the quality of biological sequencing in parallel. In order to validate the algorithm, different data sizes (1G - 20G) were used to test by different computing nodes (1 - 20) in Hadoop platform. The results show that the parallel efficiency improves continuously following with the increase of data size and computing nodes. And the algorithm has better parallel efficiency when data size and computing nodes greater than 5Gb and 10 processors. This work effectively saves the time of quality assessment of biological sequencing.

articleTitle: Research on the Security of SISOMR Wireless Channel with Artificial Noise
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Matters involved with security are those fatal matters in wireless communication field. In this paper, the security problem of SISOMR (single input single output with multiple relay-nodes) wireless channel is analyzed and solved in detail. The SISOMR wireless channel with artificial noise is designed to prevent eavesdropping. However, the artificial noise may be invalid probably due to the inherent security weakness. The SISOMR scheme is not safe through our matrix analysis. Therefore, a Relay-nodes Transmission Parameter Optimization (RTPO) scheme is proposed to fix the design flow in order to enhance the original one. Finally, the secrecy capacity of RTPO-SISOMR is introduced.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of a Pattern Matching Algorithm Based on BNDM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The improvement of the time performance of a pattern matching algorithm mainly lies in reducing the number of character comparisons and increasing the distance of text string matching window moving to the right when mismatch occurs. To solve these problems, an improved algorithm based on the combination of word frequency, BNDM and BMHS2 is proposed. Firstly, in order to reduce the number of character comparisons in each matching window, a matching algorithm based on word frequency is introduced; Secondly, in order to improve the moving distance of matching window, BMHS2 and BNDM algorithms are introduced. when mismatch occurs, the matching window is moved to the right by using a large jump distance in BNDM and BMHS2 algorithms. Finally, the time performance of the three algorithms is tested and compared by multiple experiments. Experimental results show that the improved pattern matching algorithm I_BNDM_BMHS2 improves the matching time performance to some extent compared with BNDM and BMHS2 algorithms under the same experimental conditions.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework in MIMO Downlink Transmission with Non-orthogonal Multiple Access
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Sparse code multiple access (SCMA) technique is being noted as one of the promising non-orthogonal multiple access technologies for the fifth generation (5G) wireless communications. Due to the code-domain multiplexing and message passing algorithm (MPA) implementing at the receiver, SCMA technique shows high spectral efficiency and good performance. However, when combining multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technique in downlink scenario with SCMA, the performance of these existing schemes are not satisfactory with high complexity. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for MIMO downlink transmission based on the combination of SCMA and MIMO technique to significantly improve the spectrum efficiency and guarantee the performance. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme achieves significant spectral efficiency improvement and provides satisfactory performance when combining SCMA and MIMO together.

articleTitle: A Channel Estimation and Tracking Method for OFDM Signal under High Mobile Environments
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A loss of subcarrier orthogonality in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system under high mobile environments causes an inter-carrier interference (ICI) which would lead fatal degradation of bit error rate (BER) performance. To solve the problem, this paper proposes a high accuracy time domain channel impulse response (CIR) estimation and tracking method based on pilots. Firstly, the CIR for noise suppression is obtained by using the pilots in OFDM symbols based on DFT time-frequency domain transformation. Secondly, the third-order loop filter is applied to the time-domain channel estimation. Subsequently, the channel tracking and iterative equalization are carried out symbol-by-symbol. The proposed method effectively filters the channel noise and improves the tracking performance over the fast-varying channels. Simulation results show that, the proposed method outperforms other traditional methods in terms of the channel estimation accuracy and the bit error rate. Further, the method has no complex matrix operation and has better engineering applicability than other methods.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Power Internet of Things Based on CPS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: According to the integration demand of industrialization and informatization, combining with the main problems faced by the construction of the power Internet of things, the advantages of the cyber-physical system and the power Internet of things are synergized, and the access control fusion system of the power Internet of things based on CPS is established. Based on the four processes of CPS state perception, real-time analysis, scientific decision-making and precise implementation, this paper focuses on the “cloud-side-terminal” architecture and key technologies of access control of the power Internet of things, and explores the integrated development of CPS and the power Internet of things.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Authenticated Key Agreement Scheme Integrated Privacy-Preserving Data Transmission for Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The smart grid is deeply integrated by the information network and the power grid, which enables the power system to achieve more flexible and efficient control and scheduling. However, a series of privacy issues have arisen because the smart grid environment is untrustworthy. If the criminals mine and analyze the intercepted data, they will get information such as the user’s personal information, living habits, and whether they are at home. Obviously, this is a problem that cannot be ignored and urgently needed to be solved. In this paper, we propose a lightweight privacy-preserving scheme based on the improved Diffie-Hellman protocol. We innovatively incorporate the idea of identity authentication into the DH protocol and use asymmetric cryptography to encrypt key material to protect against replay attacks. At the same time, Diffie-Hellman key negotiation technology is used to dynamically generate high-density session keys. Security performance analysis shows that when compared with the commonly used privacy protection scheme, the proposed scheme has the advantages of being lightweight, no need for trusted third party support, anti-managin attack, and facilitating the control center to connect more users.

articleTitle: Wireless Localization of Mapping Node Identifiers to Known Positions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, wireless localization has attracted great interest. However, a type of localization problem has not received much attention and has not been well studied, in which all locations of nodes are predetermined, but when nodes are deployed to these positions, the relationship between identifiers and locations of nodes is unknown. Applications with such localization problems include smart lighting, structural health, smart roads and industrial monitoring, etc. In this paper, we investigate how to map node identifiers to known locations. Although the locations of nodes are given, it is still challenging to map the node identifier to known location because the combination of mapping possibilities is huge, and incorrect mapping may occur when several known locations are close to each other. To address this problem, we first propose a localization algorithm, called Q-Hop, in which the distance of two nodes is measured by a fine-grained hop count. Then, we propose a mapping method that maps the node positions estimated by Q-Hop to known locations. The simulation results demonstrate that our solution achieves satisfactory mapping accuracy, which will provide helpful insights for applications with such localization problems.

articleTitle: A Novel Persistent In-memory Filesystem for the Fusion of Memory and Storage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Emerging non-volatile memory (NVM) technologies provide opportunities for the fusion of memory and storage. The fusion of memory and storage can exploit NVM's byte-addressability and achieve the large capacity data storage. However existing file systems built for traditional disk-based storage systems will not suit for the system based on fusion of memory and storage, which could not take full advantage of the performance that NVM should provide. Thus, it's necessary to redesign file system, over NVM medium. This paper attempts to achieve the fusion of memory and storage at the software level, which exploits NVM's byte-addressability and achieves the large capacity data storage. We converge the management of main memory and storage by implementing a file system called FRFS which optimized for NVM as the system software layer to manage the NVM medium. The proposed file system integrates the management of main memory and storage, which by adopting file page tables to fuse the memory and storage management. FRFS converges the indexing metadata and address mapping of file data into the persistent file page table. A file can be mapped into virtual address space at a constant time by embedding file page table into the calling process. Since the mapping has been established, applications can read or write the file in-place without page fault interrupt. Moreover, the addressing of file data can be efficiently handled by Memory Management Unit (MMU) hardware instead of traversing software routine, which shorting the file access path. Extensive experiments are performed on the Intel server. The results indicate that FRFS can achieve excellent performance and verify the feasibility about the fusion of memory and storage management.

Author Keywords: the fusion of memory and storage

articleTitle: “Informational Cycle Cascade” Space Distribution Analyzed with Engineering Finite Element Technology: Based on 2D Coupling Turbulence Model of Investor Sentiment for Industry
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper uses thermal-fluent coupling technology of engineering finite element to create 2D coupling turbulence model of investor sentiment for industry. It computes and analyzes space distribution of “informational cycle cascade” for investor sentiment contagion in different industries. Accompanying with information contagion among noise investors, more and more noise investors have investor sentiment under herd effect. Cloud picture of finite element shows that “informational cycle cascade” velocity and space distribution aren't uniform distribution, and its contagion is multi directions.

articleTitle: A Formation Game Based Joint Resource Scheduling Algorithm in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Resource scheduling in smart grid is a promising topic nowadays. This paper proposes a formation game based joint resource scheduling algorithm (FGRSA) by the cooperation of adjacent smart meters in the smart grid. The smart meters form a directed tree structure by using multi-hop transmission to achieve the goal of transmitting data to the access point (AP)and computational task offloading. A network formation game model is developed and using the game model, each smart meter can individually select the path connecting it to the AP while maximizing its payoff. The wireless and computing resources in the path are jointly scheduled to reduce the transmission and computing energy consumption. Simulation results show that, using the proposed FGRSA algorithm, the smart meters can self-organize into a tree structure rooted at the AP quickly. The results also show that, when the number of smart meters increase, the proposed algorithm can achieve significant gains in terms of reducing the overall energy consumption compared with the star network.

articleTitle: A New Method for Identifying the Relationship of Characters in the Video
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of information technology, more and more videos appear on the Internet. As relationship of characters is an important part of a video content, audiences can understand storyline of the video easily through the relationship. Meanwhile, the relationship can facilitate audiences to watch videos that they are interested in efficiently. In the last years, researchers have analyzed video characters in researches of video content detection. However, they treated characters as a number of independent objects and ignore their relationships. In this paper, we present a new approach to analyze the relationship of characters in a video by extracting the semantics of the video. The semantics of the video are a description of the things that made up with subtitle, action, character expression, Video semantic features are extracted and fused to identify the relationship of characters in the video. In our experiment, images are selected from the video that can easily show the relationship of the characters as the dataset. The accuracy of in the experiment is 89%. Its performance is better than the accuracy of using only one feature. At the same time, we predicted the relationship of characters using our model in Friends. The relationship of characters is almost accurately predicted under the comparison of the facts of Friends.

articleTitle: A Genetic Algorithm for Solving the Multidimensional Weighted Ring Arc-loading Problem
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The weighted ring arc-loading problem (WRALP) arose from optical communication networks using Resilient Packet Ring (RPR). RPR is bidirectional and demands that have been given can be transmitted in clockwise direction or counter-clockwise direction between nodes. Unlike previous studies considering only one-dimensional demands, this paper presents solutions to the WRALP in which multidimensional demands routed. Thus, this problem can be called the multidimensional weighted ring arc-loading problem. In order to route demands on RPR effectively, the objective is to minimize the maximum load of all arcs in all dimensions. In this paper, we use the genetic algorithm to solve this NP-complete problem, and compare the results of the genetic algorithm, the shortest path algorithm and the integer programming. Computational results show the effectiveness of genetic algorithm, especially on large-scale rings.

articleTitle: Abnormal State Detection for Rolling Bearings Using DBSE Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Rolling bearings play an important role in mechanical equipment. Abnormal state detection of rolling bearings is significant to avoid industrial accident. In this paper, we use Distribution-based States Extraction (DBSE) approach to detect and analyze the abnormal state of rolling bearings. We apply DBSE approach on three different datasets. Each dataset contains time series of horizon acceleration and vertical acceleration right before a specific fault of a rolling bearing. The results show that the DBSE is able to extract normal states and abnormal states before all three faults and effective for fault prediction. By analyzing statistical properties of two states for all three faults, we find distributions of acceleration data on two states are quite different. Further more, we find that standard deviations are more effective to describe features of different states than means of acceleration data. Our finding are great useful for abnormal detection and fault prediction.

articleTitle: LOS/NLOS Based User Grouping Scheduling Algorithm for Downlink Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system is considered as a key technology in 5G as the users' channel vectors are generally correlated with the number of antennas grows. However, in reality, the users' channel vectors are generally correlated. To achieve the good performance of the massive MIMO system, user grouping and scheduling algorithms are necessary, which separate the highly correlated users. We noticed that users under line-of-sight (LOS) and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) conditions have different characters on the channel correlation and proposed a user grouping and scheduling algorithm based on the users' LOS/NLOS conditions. Different methods are used to grouping and scheduling users with different LOS/NLOS conditions. A correlation criteria with a certain threshold is used for user grouping. The simulation results reveal that the proposed scheme can achieve a significant gain in system throughput.

articleTitle: Sparse Matrix Selection for CSR-Based SpMV Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: CSR (Compressed Sparse Row) is the most popular and widely used sparse matrix representation format for Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiplication (SpMV), which is a key operation in many scientific and engineering applications. However, considering different matrix features and the given GPUs, CSR-based SpMV on some sparse matrices does not always have better performance than that of SpMV based on other sparse matrix formats. In this paper, we explore deep learning techniques and present a methodology to select the proper sparse matrices for CSR-based SpMV on NVIDIA GPUs. To address the challenge of this matrix selection problem, we convert it to a matrix classification problem, then address this classification problem by using the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The effectiveness of our proposed methodology has been demonstrated by our experimental evaluations performed on NVIDIA GPUs.

articleTitle: Relay Selection for the Wireless Energy Harvesting Relay Assisted Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Relay assisted (RA) network with energy harvesting (EH) is a promising method to realize the green communication. Meanwhile, the relay selection (RS) is an effective method to exploit the performance advantage of EHRA network. However, the performance of RS depends on the perfect channel state information (CSI) deeply. And, there is an obvious performance gap between the RS strategy with perfect CSI and partial CSI. In order to improve the performance of EH-RA network with partial CSI, a RS strategy is proposed to optimize the spectrum efficiency (SE) under an EH constraint in this paper. The upper bounder (UB) of the proposed RS strategy is also analyzed under the perfect CSI assumption. Moreover, the statistical dynamic program (SDP) is investigated to cooperate with the proposed RS strategy by optimizing threshold under the partial CSI assumption. Numerical results show that the SE performance of the proposed RS strategy with SDP is much better than the greedy algorithm and approaches to the performance UB effectively.

articleTitle: Cyclic MUSIC Algorithm Based on Dual Cyclic Frequencies for Direction Finding
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a method of direction finding for linear array sensors by exploiting the symmetry of signal cyclostationary in the cyclic frequency domain. A new cyclic cross-correlation matrix is constructed utilizing the positive and negative cyclic frequencies, and then MUSIC algorithm is used to estimate direction of arrival of the sources. Compared with the existing algorithms, the proposed algorithm has better angle resolution under low SNR condition when the sources impinge on the array from closely directions and the computational complexity is little higher than SC-SSF and GACM algorithm but far lower than others. Moreover, the proposed algorithm can be applied for both narrow-band and wide-band signals. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Structural Reweight Spares Subspace Clustering under Unknown Noise
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Sparse subspace clustering (SSC) aims at achieving state-of-the-art clustering performance via solving a l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> minimization problem. The l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> norm is used to instead of l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> norm for finding a sparse matrix C. Reweight sparse subspace clustering (RSSC) proposed an iterative reweighting l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> minimization algorithm for an accurate neighbor identification. This paper is inspired by RSSC and SSC. By reweighting the sparse subspace clustering algorithm, the proposed method can obtain a more appropriate representation of data. The proposed algorithm also generalizes a modified two-step l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> minimization algorithm for solving clustering noise datasets problem. Even if we don't know the type or any parameter of the noise, the algorithm can perform better. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate the effect of our algorithm. Especially when there are noise, the proposed algorithm has excellent clustering effect. Experiments on Extended Yale B and ORL show that our algorithm can have state-of-the-art performance on real datasets.

articleTitle: Performance of Polar Code in DP-16QAM Coherent Optical Communication System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper studies the performance of polar code in DP-16QAM coherent optical communication system. Three typical construction methods of polar code are compared and analyzed: Bhattacharyya parameters construction, Gauss approximation construction and Monte-Carlo construction. The bit error rate (BER) performance of the three methods under different design signal-to-noise ratios (design-SNRs) is analyzed. A multi-level polar coding method DP-MLC which combined the two polarization of DP-16QAM is proposed. The BER performance of the proposed method is compared with the traditional BICM system. The simulation result shows that the performance of the three methods is different under different design-SNRs. The Monte Carlo method is the best among all the construction methods when the design-SNR is 1.5dB. The proposed DP-MLC is better than the traditional BICM system. Under the same conditions, the average optical signal-to-noise ratio is saved by 0.5dB.

articleTitle: The Research of Forensic Voiceprint Identification Based on WMFCC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The characteristic comparison of formants is an important method for voice identification. In order to solve the key problems of voice identification, a weighted Mel Frequency Cepstrum Coefficient (WMFCC) which can be used for formats extraction from the voice signal is proposed in this paper. The WMFCC coefficient which contains the main components of the frequency spectrum can be obtained by analyzing short-time voice signal. The candidate formants can be obtained from the formant position of spectral envelope parameters. The accurate formant location would be fixed by analyzing the main components of signal spectrum. The resonance formats analysis of Nasal vowels; the vowel resonance formants contrast and Long Term Mean Power Spectrum Analysis were used for the Voiceprint identification. The experiment shows fewer errors of the formants based on WMFCC were smaller, and it shows better robustness in noisy environment.

articleTitle: Acoustic Signal-based Leak Size Estimation for Electric Valves Using Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To achieve the balance of plant, industrial valves are extensively used for critical safety and control functions. Conventionally, the threshold and the visual observation method are used for valve health monitoring. However, these methods are slow. This study presents a systematic application of deep belief network (DBN) for fault size estimation in the DN50 electric gate valve. First, real acoustic signals representing the malfunctions are acquired. Secondly, the influence of the transmission path and background noise from other equipment are decoupled, using wavelet packet decomposition and reconstruction. Finally, three different DBN models are developed for valve internal leakage assessment, using the original signals, time-domain parameters and the decomposed wavelet packets. Evaluation results show that the model trained with the time-domain signals achieve the optimal result. The model also shows the capability to automatically extract the deep features from the signal, escaping the dependence on the conventional signal processing method and reducing the signal processing time. The application of DBN for size estimation also solves the slow convergence problems in the conventional multi-layer, backpropagation neural networks.

articleTitle: Multi-Task Collaborative Scheduling System for Industrial Control Data Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Network scanners, honeypots and network crawlers are developed to collect the data in Industrial Control System. However, each software or system lacks uniform management rules due to the different developers and development environments. It is urgent to develop a multi-task collaborative scheduling system for the data collection in Industrial Control System in order to make full use of existing hardware and software resources, save human resource costs, and improve the real-time and accuracy of data collection and fusion tasks. The paper proposes a heterogeneous inter-node communication architecture for industrial control data acquisition and researches the evaluation model of resource node and task. An urgent sorting scheduling algorithm and preemptive scheduling algorithm is proposed to solve the multidimensional scheduling requirements and real-time problems of industrial control data collection tasks.

articleTitle: Orthogonal-path Schedule Algorithm for MSM Clos-network Switching Fabric
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the issue that the traditional schedule algorithms are usually proposed for the uniform model of MSM (Memory-Space-Memory) Clos-network, it is needed to design a proprietary and dedicated algorithm with corresponding architecture for switching fabric. This paper presents a novel orthogonal path schedule algorithm (OPSA) based on self-designed MSM Clos-network. The algorithm focuses on eliminating the request-grant-accept delay brought by traditional algorithms, such as concurrent dispatching (CD) and concurrent round-robin dispatching (CRRD), and simplifying the system architecture as well as reducing the complexity of hardware design. Specifically, according to the dynamic updated path status between IM and OM, different IMs are dispatched with orthogonal paths that can be used to transmit data without any conflict during each time slot. Besides, variable length packet and fixed-length cells are adopted to accelerate pipe-line processing efficiency. The experimental results show that OPSA we proposed not only can guarantee the switching delay in the proper range, but also can achieve 100% throughput in optimal conditions. In addition, the algorithm complexity of OPSA is obviously decreased, while reducing the hardware consumption.

articleTitle: Two-Layer 3DoF+ System Based on Ultra-High Resolution Panoramic Video
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: 3DoF+ supports limited movements of the user to better interact with the video contents. It provides user with more detailed information by utilizing the ultra-high resolution panoramic video. However, such high-resolution video poses a great challenge to network bandwidth and client performance. In this paper, a two-layer based 3DoF+ panoramic video system is proposed utilizing the ultra-high resolution panoramic video. According to the user's viewpoint, this system will select different layer videos to display to provide users with a real overall zooming viewing experience, while effectively saving bandwidth. Experimental results show that the proposed system saves 85.95% transmission bandwidth than the traditional system in average.

articleTitle: Fast GIS Browsing Services Based on In-Memory Database for Large-scale Distribution Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Geographic Information System (GIS) is the essential data management and visualization platform for transmission and distribution power network planning, operation scheduling, and repair decision support systems. SQL-based on-the-fly rendering or pre-generated-tiles-based static rendering methods cannot meet the dynamic graphical browsing requirements of provincial-scale GIS systems for distribution networks. An object-oriented in-memory database is introduced, which loads all the geometry and attribute data into the main memory of the GIS application server. It supports all the spatial query and dynamic browser without the need to do disk I/O. The implementations of partitioned data management, spatial index, and dynamic vector graphic browsing service are detailed. The stress test results of an actual system are presented.

articleTitle: Secondary User Utility Optimization Algorithm on Cooperative Spectrum Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The key technology of cognitive radio is spectrum sensing. This paper combines the incentive mechanism of crowd-sensing with cooperative spectrum sensing, and proposes a game-based cooperative spectrum sensing algorithm with optimal utility of secondary users(SUs). Firstly, the utility function of all SUs is established considering the platform budget, detection probability, transmission distance, and remaining power comprehensively. The optimal sensing time of each SU is obtained through game. Then SUs evaluate the utility and select whether to upload detection probability. Finally the platform selects a certain number of users with high detection probability and calculates the final detection probability through voting fusion. The simulation results show that the algorithm can improve the average utility of SUs, greatly reduce the energy consumption of SUs who have less remaining energy and prolong the standby time.

articleTitle: AIK-Means: A Novel Clustering Method for Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing data provides abundant information for biologist to understand unknown life mystery. Instead of microarray data from bulk cells with their mean values, single cell expression data is independent between genes which enables specific research. For large gene expression data sets analysis, an important step is clustering genes or cells into several modules according to biological functions or biology processes. Although there are many clustering methods have been proposed even some of them specified at single cell expression data sets, low accuracy and robustness are still problems to be solved. In addition, initial parameter selection will impact the method effect. Here, we present AIK-means, an integrated clustering algorithm based on k-means aiming to improve clustering accuracy with high stability. The proposed method can also choose parameter cluster k and initial centers automatically by using few prior knowledge information. Compared to several relevant tools, AIK-means performed well in published single cell dataset.

articleTitle: Design of Network Information Security Knowledge Assessment System Based on Unity3D
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For the network security teaching, it is necessary to carry on the virtual simulation to the course content, which can simulate all kinds of situations more comprehensively, and this is the incomparable advantage of the traditional method. Course knowledge can be displayed more scientifically, so that students' acceptance can be enhanced, and students can be involved through interactive operation, thus reducing the cost of security exercises in reality. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the virtual simulation technology of Unity3D, master more scientific use methods, and improve the adaptability of technology. This paper focuses on the application of virtual environment simulation technology in Unity3D, human-computer interaction and database management.

articleTitle: Research on Technology Related to Intelligent Producing of Globe Based on User Customization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Not only the producing technique and the function of the globe has changed with the changing of the users' requirement and the artificial intelligence's permeating, but also the requirement of the users' for the globe is different and complex. For this situation, this article has brought forward the intelligent globe producing technique basing on the user customization, expounded the producing flow, and testified this technique having the excellence of customizing easily, making fast, low cost, high satisfaction and some intelligent assistant deciding ability by the experiment basing on analyzing the two key factors of the globe producing technique and the advantage and disadvantage.

articleTitle: Load Forecasting for City Cloud NSSA System Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Substantial progress has been achieved in improving the accuracy and speed of load forecasting for city cloud network security situation awareness (NSSA) system structure. In this paper, the radial basis function (RBF) neural network for awareness was optimized by using the alternating gradient algorithm, so as to forecast the load for city cloud NSSA. The modified simulation algorithm based on experimental data was powerful in load forecasting for city cloud NSSA. Compared with the conventional gradient algorithm for network awareness, the modified algorithm featured faster convergence speed and higher load forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Clustering Structure Based Time Switching Power Control optimization for Energy Harvesting Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Energy harvesting technology provides neoteric possibilities for prolonging the service life of mobile nodes in Ad-Hoc networks. In this paper, we focus on using energy harvesting technology in clustering structure based Ad-Hoc networks to decrease the system total power consumption as well as prolong the lifetime of the cluster. Distinct from the way in which a base station transmits energy to multiple mobile nodes in a general wireless network, we propose a scheme that the process of energy harvesting occurs at the cluster head which is able to receive information and harvest energy from dedicated subcarriers sent by the cluster members so as to alleviate burdens on its battery. We split the communication slot into two parts, energy transmission and information transmission, and formulate an optimization problem to obtain its optimal time switching ratio which will determine the power of each subcarrier and affect the energy consumption performance of the networks. Simulation results show that our proposed scheme can substantially reduce system power consumption and prolong the cluster's lifetime under different channel conditions, numerical analysis also proves that it is feasible to expand the capacity of cluster with less cost.

articleTitle: Design of Charging Power Supply Management System for Electric Toys
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At present, electric toys belong to high-end consumer electronic toys. Due to the popularity of supercapacitors, the use of supercapacitors as electrical energy storage units is more practical, reliable and convenient than the early nickel-hydrogen rechargeable batteries. Therefore, many toys have adopted the “rechargeable” function, which plays an important role in promoting the grade and quality of toys. However, how to design in the actual charging power management system for toys with “electricity” brings difficulties to toy design engineers. In this paper, three typical designs of constant current charging power supply, constant voltage charging power supply and constant current and constant voltage charging power supply are analyzed, and a more reasonable power management system design of three types of circuits is given based on the application of the current most mainstream new power management chip.

articleTitle: A Low Latency Polar Coded Modulation Scheme for Noncoherent MIMO
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With end-to-end latency constantly emphasized in next generation wireless communication, we present a novel low latency polar coded modulation scheme for noncoherent multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) channel. Parallel demodulation structure is utilized in our scheme in order to reduce the latency of noncoherent MIMO demodulation. Moreover, by splitting a whole polar code into several component codes, we increase the parallelism of polar decoding to further reduce latency. Besides, an efficient and practical polar code construction method is provided. Complexity analysis and numerical simulation show that system latency is significantly reduced with a trivial error performance loss.

articleTitle: Low-Complexity RTS Detection Algorithm in Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a low-complexity uplink signal detection algorithm based on reactive tabu search (RTS) in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. As the number of antennas increases, conventional RTS algorithm achieves near-maximum likelihood (ML) performance in massive MIMO systems. But the complexity of the initial solution vector is too high. Therefore, we propose a symmetric successive over-relaxation RTS (SSOR-RTS) algorithm which achieves the same error rate performance of RTS but with lower complexity. The key idea is to calculate the initial solution vector of RTS algorithm using the SSOR iterative method. A criterion based on ML cost change rate to limit the number of SSOR iterations is also proposed to further reduce the complexity of the RTS algorithm. Simulation results show that the SSOR-RTS and adaptive SSOR-RTS achieve almost the same performance with RTS algorithm at significantly less complexity.

articleTitle: Wideband Bandpass Filter with Controllable Bandwidth and High Selectivity Using Dual-behavior Resonators and Coupled Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this article, a novel wideband bandpass filter with controllable bandwidth and high selectivity using dual-behavior resonators (DBRs) and coupled lines (CLs) is proposed. The filter has a symmetrical structure consisting of a parallel-coupled line and two identical open-ended stubs. The center frequency and relative bandwidth of the filter can be determined by the parallel-coupled line. And two transmission zeros (TZs) near the passband can be adjusted by using open-ended stubs, which enhances the passband selectivity of the proposed filter. In order to testify the advantages of the proposed filter, theoretical analysis and simulation are carried out. As a result, the Electromagnetic (EM) simulation shows that the filter has five zeros and three poles. Thus, the filter has high selectivity.

articleTitle: Accelerating DFA Construction Based on Hierarchical Merging
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Deterministic Finite Automaton (DFA) is widely employed in performing fast regular expression matching for numerous network applications. However, constructing DFA recognizing a set of regular expressions is time-consuming especially when the set is huge. In this paper, an improved approach is introduced to accelerate DFA construction based on the hierarchical merging method. The experiments demonstrate that the improved approach proposed in this paper performs about 1.6 to 3.4 times faster than the original hierarchical merging method, and 120 to 1500 times faster than the classical subset construction algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Forecast of Aircraft Spare Parts Based on Fractional Order Discrete Grey Model
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Exact spare parts demand forecast is an important task of equipment maintenance support. In spare parts demand forecast of aircraft, there exists problems such as the lack of comparable existing equipments, less historical data of fault or spare parts demand and lack of understanding of the aircraft’s own guarantee characteristics. In this paper, a spare parts demand forecast method based on fractional-order discrete gray model is proposed. In this method, a fractional-order cumulative gray model is established from historical data containing “small sample” and “poor information Then, the genetic algorithm is applied to determine the optimal order of the model and the generation coefficient. Finally, the spare parts demand is predicted. Experimental results based on specific examples show that the proposed method can effectively predict the spare parts demand, and have good performance compared with the traditional integer-order model.

articleTitle: Preoperative Prediction of Prosthetic Size in Total Knee Arthroplasty Based on Multimodal Data and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Total knee arthroplasty (TKA) is an effective treatment method for severe knee osteoarthritis and other knee-related diseases. Accurate match of prostheses is a crucial factor to improve the clinical efficacy and patients' postoperative satisfaction in TKA, to which no enough attention is paid currently. In this paper, we introduce deep learning algorithm to analyze the patients' multimodal data, such as preoperative radiograph of knees and relevant physical features (e.g. sex, height, weight), and design a software system for preoperative prediction of prosthetic type in TKA. The main processing steps include the pre-processing of X-ray images and the prediction of prosthetic type based on convolutional neural network. Research on loss function and model structure is implemented to fit the dataset better for further improvement of prediction accuracy. Transfer learning method is employed to address the problem of inadequate data. The experimental results shows that our prediction system can achieve the same accuracy level compared with that of traditional methods manipulated by experienced doctors, while it can complete the preoperative prediction automatically with lower cost and better stability.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity Joint Detection and Decoding Algorithm for MIMO-LDPC System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Joint detection and decoding (JDD) algorithm has recently received extensive attention due to its excellent performance. Responding to the requirements of the 5thgeneration communication system with high rate and low latency, a low complexity joint detection and decoding (LCJDD) algorithm for MIMO-LDPC system has been proposed. The computational complexity of the proposed algorithm is significantly lower than that of systems using JDD blocks, and the performance loss can be controlled to be within about 0.5 dB.

Author Keywords: low complexity joint detection and decoding(LC-JDD)

articleTitle: An Efficient Encoding Method for Spatially Coupled Low-Density Parity-Check Codes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient encoding scheme for spatially coupled low-density parity-check (SC-LDPC) codes is proposed. In order to lower the error floor, we optimize the degree distribution of SC-LDPC codes and propose a split variable nodes algorithm constructing sub-matrices with large girth of SC-LDPC codes. The corresponding sliding window decoding is studied as well to fasten the decoding convergence. Simulation results show that on the AWGN channel, SC-LDPC codes can obtain better error performance, lower decoding complexity and faster decoding convergence as compared with the LDPC block codes (LDPC-BC).

articleTitle: Summarizing the Crowdsourced Testing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Testing a new Android application is hard, since the android platform has a lot of portability and compatibility issues. These issues are caused by its fragmentation and diversified operating-system versions, as well as varied hardware platforms, which can hardly be addressed. Due to this fact, crowdsourcing emerged as an ideal way to perform the android testing, as workers possess devices that could cover a large amount of both the operation-system versions and the hardware platforms. Additionally, the diversified network settings of crowdsourced workers contribute to this task. However, the manual reporting process can be cumbersome and still need some professional background, which dampens the enthusiasm of the workers. In this paper, we propose a framework to summarize the crowdsourced Android testing, which endeavours to ease the workload of workers during the process of crowdsourcing.

articleTitle: Optimization Analysis of Wireless Sensing Signal Fusion Processing Based on BPNN and DS Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to further improve the timeliness and quality of wireless communication, an optimization method of wireless sensing signal fusion processing based on BPNN and DS evidence theory is proposed. The basic idea of the method: PSO is used as the link between BPNN and DS evidence theory in the field of wireless sensing signals, and achieves the global optimal solution process in signal processing and wireless communication. In the signal acquisition stage of wireless sensor nodes, BPNN is used to realize the artificial intelligence acquisition process of signal output, and PSO is used to realize the global optimal allocation of signal weight from signal acquisition input to signal output analysis; in the information fusion stage of wireless communication, DS evidence theory is used to realize the information fusion process, and PSO is used to realize the global optimal solution of information discrimination evidence synthesis. By proposing the joint innovation mode of the above intelligent algorithms, the main contributions of this paper are as follows: with the BPNN with PSO method, redundant signal compression processing and signal analysis efficiency can be improved; with the DS evidence theory with PSO method, the accuracy of information discrimination for wireless communication can be improved. This scientifically reconciles the contradiction between signal compression and information extraction.

articleTitle: Three Satellites Detection Trajectory Estimation Algorithm Based on the Thrust Acceleration Template
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve the trajectory estimation accuracy of the three satellites detection, an estimation algorithm based on the thrust acceleration template is proposed. Firstly, using STK to analyze the SBIRS's regional coverage capability, about 43% of the time can achieve complete coverage of the selected region by more than three satellites. Secondly, constructing the thrust acceleration template by using the ballistic missile prior information, after that, extending the thrust direction angles to the components of the target's state vector, then a parametric dynamic model with high precision is established. Furthermore, the thrust direction is approximated by the missile initial position direction. Finally, using the UKF to estimate the missile motion state in real time. Experimental results show that, compared with the algorithm based on the CS model, the estimation errors of this algorithm are significantly reduced, and this algorithm is more robust.

articleTitle: Improved ORB Algorithm Based on Binocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In digital image processing, feature extraction is a very important step, and ORB algorithm is the best one in real-time performance, but it is not up to the standard in the system with higher real-time requirements. Through binocular vision calibration, we will delve into how to speed up the operation of ORB algorithm with ensuring accuracy. First, the overlapping regions of the left and right images are extracted, and then the images are subjected to morphological operations, and corner detection is performed at the edges. Secondly, the original description method is improved, and the description sub-selects the window value based on the area ring, which is more in line with the characteristics of the human eye and improves the operation speed. Then, a hierarchical matching strategy is adopted, combined with binocular visual constraints, the matching range is defined, and the accuracy is effectively improved. Finally, construct an experimental platform to process two images and compare them with existing algorithms. The experimental results show that the proposed method has much less computational time consumption than the original algorithm under the condition of improved accuracy, and is suitable for fast matching environment.

articleTitle: Service Function Chain Deployment Based on Improved Viterbi Algorithm in 5G-C-RAN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper designs a service function chain deployment algorithm. The service function chain is under the 5G-C-RAN architecture. We build the combine profit model to maximize the utility for the virtual wireless access network. It optimizes the end-to-end delay limit and service rate requirements of mobile virtual network operator(MVNO) with resource Infrastructure Provider (InP) constraint. The Viterbi algorithm is modified to realize the deployment of the service function chain. Experiments show that the method has good performance in terms of service processing time, request acceptance rate, combine profit and algorithm execution time.

articleTitle: Energy-Aware Sampling Set Selection for Signal Reconstruction in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 5th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Emerging technologies surge the rapid development of the Internet of things (IoT).
